request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Make every brown glove, sleeve, strap, belt, boot and satchel charcoal grey, and make the bright red tunic bigger so it covers his chest, belly and legs down to the knees, with its patches the same bright red. Keep the olive green face, the red flying cap with round iron goggles, the round black bomb raised high with its small pale spark, pose, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under his feet.
